name: Hysteresis Episode + Fan-Stack Ladder Trend Method
description: Trend method using a primary hysteresis episode boundary pair (default g38 vs g83) to define episodes,
a ladder of Gaussian fan stacks (23–83, 38–83, 53–83, 68–83) to measure drift/structure/shape,
dynamic thresholds based on rolling 60-minute baselines (percentiles + MAD),
and an early-probe pair (g23 vs g83) to detect early collapse/exhaustion inside an episode.
Outputs Bull/Bear/Neutral + confidence + stage + ETA-to-end when collapsing.

episode_primary_switch.reason: Slow-market regimes can form long hysteresis with few (38,83) crossings; (53,83) yields a cleaner macro episode clock.

disorder.notes: Treat as DISORDER if cross_rate is in the top quartile of the last-hour baseline OR eff_order is not ok.

start.definition: last sign flip of d_primary within episode_lookback_seconds
start.fallback: if no sign flip found in lookback, treat as 'episode_in_progress' with unknown start; stage based on current spread dynamics.

end.definition: next sign flip of d_primary after start
end.action: close current episode, log summary, immediately open new episode with start at end timestamp

rules.name: EARLY
rules.when: fanned OR (spread rising) AND episode_elapsed_seconds < 0.35 * median_episode_duration
rules.notes: If no median exists yet, use 2*epoch_seconds as a placeholder.

rules.name: MID
rules.when: spread near local max OR |dW_norm| small while spread is high

rules.name: LATE
rules.when: collapse AND spread above tight threshold
rules.notes: Fan collapsing; end-cross more likely soon.

rules.name: TRANSITION
rules.when: DISORDER dominates OR order breaks down across stacks
rules.notes: High internal crossings; avoid directional commits.

confidence_adjustments.notes: Strong unison drift; can override most guardrails unless explicitly DISORDER.

conditions: eff_order_ok remains true OR only mildly degraded
trend direction still has ladder consensus
FAN_COLLAPSE.decision: trend = sign(m) (continuation bias) but runway shorter

conditions: cross_rate in top quartile baseline OR eff_order_ok == false on most stacks OR stacks disagree on direction
spread is tight on most stacks

valid_stack_criteria: not flagged as DISORDER by extreme cross_rate (optional soft exclusion)

direction_vote.quality_i: Q_i in [0,1] derived from |m_norm|, eff_order, W_pct, and cross_rate

best_valid_stack_selection.rule: choose the highest-resolution stack among valid stacks in order S0,S1,S2,S3
best_valid_stack_selection.purpose: caps confidence when more sensitive sigmas are unavailable or too noisy

signals.name: PROBE_FLIP_EARLY
signals.definition: sign flip in d_probe occurs while d_primary has not flipped
signals.effect: reduce confidence and shorten ETA; mark 'flip_watch' true

signals.name: PROBE_FAST_COLLAPSE
signals.definition: abs(d_probe) shrinking rapidly (d|d_probe|/dt strongly negative) while primary still trending
signals.effect: reduce confidence; bias regime toward FAN_COLLAPSE

impulse_exhaustion_pullback_gate.description: Late-chase protection: if a strong impulse has expanded and is now exhausting + pulling back (fan collapse + probe weakening), gate can force Neutral or reduce confidence/ETA without changing core regime logic.
trigger_when: spread is fanned on >=1 of [S0,S1,S2] (W >= W_p75) in recent window
probe shows exhaustion: PROBE_FAST_COLLAPSE OR d_probe sign flip while d_primary not flipped
drift weakening: abs(m_norm) falling vs prior tail window OR vote_norm decreasing

actions._note_toggle_force_neutral: If you want this gate to NOT force Neutral (only cap confidence + add notes), change force_neutral to false.

g8_usage: g8 is not part of structural ladder voting.
It may be used later as a micro-burst overlay to lower confidence during instability or flag early breakout watch.
neutral_policy: Prefer Neutral when DISORDER dominates or drift is flat, even if short-lived g23 movements occur.
TIGHT_DRIFT may override guardrails except when regime is DISORDER/TRANSITION.
future_tuning: Percentiles (25/75) and normalized thresholds (0.5/1.0) are initial defaults and can be tuned by backtest.
Episode duration baseline should accumulate online (median duration per boundary pair).
